dataset: UCDP GED v23.1 (Uppsala Conflict Data Program - Georeferenced Event Dataset)
notes: Deaths use the 'best' estimate column; date range from date_start/date_end. Dataset version ged231 covers events through 2023-12-31 (UCDP releases lag ~1 year). All original GED columns retained. NOTE: the task brief said Kenya country_id=470, but in UCDP GED Kenya is country_id=501 (Gleditsch-Ward); filtering was done on country_id=501 AND country='Kenya' (1126 rows, 0 mismatches). Citation: Sundberg & Melander (2013) JPR 50(1); HEG v23.1 by Pettersson, Högbladh & Öberg (2019/2021). License: free for scholarly/reference use with citation.
